Sent · Just now

Barkers AI Agent · AI

Barkers AI Agent · AI says:

If a gifted item needs to be exchanged, there are a couple of options depending on how it was purchased:

For online orders, use the returns courier label included with your parcel and fill out the Returns / Exchanges Form when sending the item back.
For in-store exchanges, simply bring the garment and proof of purchase to your nearest Barkers store.
If the item was bought in-store, the original receipt is usually required. If it was purchased under a Barkers & Co loyalty account, the transaction can be located for you.
Please ensure the item is in its original, unwashed condition with all labels and swing tags attached. Items that have been worn, washed, damaged, or altered cannot be exchanged or refunded for a change of mind.

If proof of purchase cannot be found, the Barkers team can assist further.
